findings.passage: Under his leadership, the Texas Legislature successfully passed $2.8 billion for enhanced border security, reformed our broken bail system, strengthened the integrity of our elections, and passed key pro-life measures.
findings.note: Re-election announcement carried by a San Angelo news site, marked as authored by him on 2021-10-20. It lists strengthening the integrity of elections among the 2021 session results, without naming SB 1 or any ID rule.
SB 14 (2011), requires a voter to present proof of identification. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; last action on the page is 05/27/2011.

SB 5 (2017), requires a voter to present proof of identification, with the page showing the enrolled version. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; last action on the page is 06/01/2017.

SB 1 (2021 second called session), election integrity law that, among other things, sets ID-number rules for mail ballots. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; last action on the page is 09/07/2021.

SB 16 (2025), requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a limited federal ballot for those who cannot supply it. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; page shows House committee report sent to Calendars 05/25/2025.
